title: Cherry on Top Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Cherry On Top is a 2 BR / 2 BA / 7 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Located in the stunning community of Seaside, Florida, Cherry on Top is a gorgeous home that features third level panoramic views, a heightened level of comfort, and a touch of elegance that will make your vacation a delight.
description_expanded: Description720 FOREST STREET1 KING, 2 QUEENS, 1 DOUBLE SLEEPER SOFACherry on Top | A Bright & Spacious Seaside Retreat on Forest StreetCherry on Top is a charming and spacious vacation rental in Seaside, Florida, offering colorful coastal style, multiple outdoor living spaces, and accommodations for up to seven guests. Perfectly located on Forest Street, this three-story beach home places you within walking distance of the beach, the West Side pool, Ruskin Place, the Seaside Chapel, and the heart of town—making it an ideal choice for families and groups seeking a classic Seaside getaway.Open Living Spaces Filled with Natural LightDesigned with high ceilings and an abundance of windows, Cherry on Top feels bright, airy, and welcoming from the moment you arrive. The first floor features a spacious living room with ample seating and a 55-inch flat-screen television, ideal for relaxing after a day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, which comfortably seats eight and invites long meals, laughter, and game nights.Tucked toward the back of the home is a cozy den with a sleeper sofa, along with a full bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. Guests will also enjoy the enclosed outdoor shower and the expansive deck shaded by oak and pine trees, complete with outdoor dining and Adirondack seating for enjoying the coastal breeze.Comfortable Bedrooms & Thoughtful LayoutThe second floor continues the home’s bright, open feel with soaring ceilings and well-appointed sleeping spaces. The king primary suite offers a peaceful retreat and opens to a private deck. Across the hall, a generous guest bedroom features two queen beds, providing ample space for family or friends. A full bathroom is conveniently located between the bedrooms, along with a washer and dryer for added ease during your stay.Just off the landing, a large screened porch invites guests to slow down and unwind. Furnished with Adirondack seating, a bistro table for two, and a swing, this serene space is perfect for morning coffee or an afternoon escape.A Third-Floor Tower with Sunset ViewsTrue to its name, the third floor is the “cherry on top” of this Seaside home. The enclosed tower sitting area is surrounded by windows on three sides, filling the space with natural light. Step outside onto the observation deck, where Adirondack chairs offer the perfect vantage point for sunset views, evening breezes, and quiet moments after a full day by the Gulf.Walkable Seaside Location Near Beach, Pools & TownLocated on Forest Street in Seaside, FL, Cherry on Top offers one of the most convenient locations in town. Guests are just a short stroll from the beach, the West Side pool, Ruskin Place, Central Square, and Seaside’s iconic shops and dining. Whether you’re biking through town, enjoying sunset views, or relaxing on one of the home’s many porches, Cherry on Top delivers a classic Seaside experience designed for making lasting memories.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES1,860 square feet176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessTwo dedicated desks, ideal for remote workWithin walking distance of a Tesla charging station for three vehiclesTower with viewsEnhanced Eero WiFi system for strong signal throughout the homeXbox OneOutdoor dining on the deckPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking policy: one parking pass for one-bedroom cottages and two parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes; golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf carts for non-homeowners are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a permitNo petsSTR23-001960
